original: WPRPLACE or WPRPLACEen is a fjord located in the Ryfylke area in Rogaland county in southwestern Norway. The 42-kilometre long fjord lies in Strand Municipality and Sandnes Municipality, about 25 kilometres east of the city of Stavanger.
